Blank the lowest axis label

Source: R/label-drop-first.R
label_drop_first.Rd

Wraps a label function so the lowest visible break is left unlabeled while its tick is kept. Useful in tightly stacked tracks, where the lowest y-axis label of one track collides with the highest label of the track below it.

Usage

label_drop_first(labels = scales::label_number())

Arguments

labels

Label function to wrap, default: scales::label_number()

Value

Label function for the labels argument of a scale

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ggplot2::ggplot(gistic) +
  geom_ridge_track(ggplot2::aes(y = G.score)) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = label_drop_first()) +
  coord_locus("chr13:48303751-48481890", flank = 1e6) +
  theme_genomic(x_axis = "ticks")
} # }
